key.title: Take your Nostr key
key.intro: When you signed up with email, BIES made a Nostr key for you and has held it since. It is your identity on Nostr: your profile, listings and Trust Score are tied to it.
key.same: Everything stays the same: your profile, followers, listings, Trust Score and membership.
key.signIn: From then on you sign in with Nostr, using your key or a signer app. Signing in by email stops working.
key.deleted: BIES deletes its copy as soon as you show you saved yours.
key.noRecovery: Nobody can recover a lost key, not even BIES. Keep it somewhere safe, like a password manager.
key.backups: Our backups still hold the key, encrypted, until they expire within 90 days.
key.codeStep: Enter the code we emailed you to see your key.
key.keyWarning: Anyone with this key can act as you on Nostr. Never share it, and never paste it into a site you don't trust.

key.backupDesc: A file locked with a password you choose. You can sign in to BIES with it later.

key.wrongKey: That isn't the key we gave you. Check you copied all of it.
key.notAKey: That doesn't look like a key or a backup.
key.wrongPassword: Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
key.doneBody: BIES deleted its copy. You're still signed in here; on your other devices, sign in with Nostr.
key.doneHow: Next time, choose "Sign in with Nostr", then paste your key, open your backup file, or use a signer app.
key.notHosted: BIES holds no key for this account: you already hold your own.
key.signContent: I have saved my Nostr key. BIES can delete its copy.
